availability: Every field is implemented. Genuine empty/non-applicable zero is not an unavailable measurement. Snapshots and descriptor tokens are numeric metadata, never payload authority.
oracleScope: Public-only linear programs independently model an alignment-one two-field layout, full nested ownership/permission records, preparation, activation, destructive movement, bounded read, explicit charged detach and cleanup. Empty descriptors/fields execute real control lifetimes without fabricated native events. Pointer alignment, provider failures, incomplete/cancelled publication, retry and history exhaustion remain separately linked local proofs.
unreviewedScope: These final 24 field definitions complete 251 declared diagnostic properties, not all public API/lifecycle/event-kind combinations, generated safety schedules, benefit/cost evidence, native platforms or release delivery.

schemas.scope: One authenticated typed field in an immutable reusable descriptor, independent of any payload owner's lifetime.
schemas.consistency: Immutable after checked descriptor construction; no live backing is accessed or retained.
schemas.resetPolicy: Immutable shape facts survive owner return and process measurement reset.
schemas.historyOverflow: No histories; dimensions and alignment are checked before descriptor mutation.

fields.name: LayoutId
fields.definition: Checked immutable process-local descriptor identity, not owner/allocation identity or lifetime authority.
fields.implementation: NativeLayout.cs#return new(Id, field.Index, region.Length, Unsafe.SizeOf<T>(), region.Offset, region.Bytes, region.Alignment);

fields.name: Index
fields.definition: Zero-based authenticated position in the descriptor, including valid empty fields; not an independent owner.

fields.name: Length
fields.definition: Declared checked nonnegative element count, including zero; no initialization status is implied.

fields.name: ElementBytes
fields.definition: Actual unmanaged runtime type size, excluding descriptor/control storage.
fields.overflow: Runtime unmanaged size, not a guessed CLR object size.

fields.name: OffsetBytes
fields.definition: Checked field start after inter-field alignment, relative to the aligned common payload, not raw backing base.

fields.name: PayloadBytes
fields.definition: Checked element count times actual element size; excludes padding, base slack and ownership overhead.

fields.name: Alignment
fields.definition: Validated field alignment, at least actual natural alignment and at most 64, not an inferred malloc alignment.

schemas.scope: One real common-lifetime backing control and its immutable descriptor. Nested records describe the same charge, never separate allocations. Descriptor/control field bytes exclude CLR headers/padding.
schemas.consistency: Sampled control metadata, not a cross-domain transaction. Exact multi-field reconciliation uses quiescent operations; entered borrow counters may change independently. Stale/returned non-default numeric snapshots do not restore authority.
schemas.resetPolicy: Shape, completed preparation/initialization flags, peaks and copy histories survive movement and terminal return. Current initialized/storage gauges clear only on actual resource return. Process measurement reset does not rewrite owner histories.
schemas.historyOverflow: Copied bytes and successful detach counts saturate with sticky layout overflow; unique/permission histories retain their independently implemented flags. Exact current charges and checked identities never wrap.

fields.name: LayoutId
fields.definition: Immutable reusable descriptor identity, distinct from this owner/control identity.

fields.name: Ownership
fields.definition: All twenty actual unique-control fields on the same backing, including complete owned extent and typed initialized bytes. Numeric capture cannot create a live owner.
fields.overflow: Nested exact gauges/checked identities and independently saturating histories.

fields.name: Reservation
fields.definition: All eighteen actual permission/control fields on the same charge, including pending/prepared/activated/failure history; not another native allocation.
fields.overflow: Nested exact gauges/checked identities and independently saturating histories.

fields.name: RegionCount
fields.definition: Immutable declared field count, including zero-length fields; at most 64.

fields.name: InitializedRegionCount
fields.definition: All declared fields while activated payload remains owned, otherwise zero; completed but cancelled initialization is not published.
fields.overflow: Bounded immutable count, no partial publication.

fields.name: LogicalInitializedBytes
fields.definition: Live activated typed payload only, excluding padding/slack; zero before publication and after actual return.

fields.name: LayoutExtentBytes
fields.definition: Immutable common payload extent including inter-region padding, excluding base-alignment slack.

fields.name: InterRegionPaddingBytes
fields.definition: Immutable extent minus typed logical bytes; does not include alignment slack outside the payload.

fields.name: AlignmentSlackBytes
fields.definition: Complete admitted backing minus payload extent, alignment minus one for nonempty backing and genuine zero for empty extent. Not hidden allocator overhead/RSS.

fields.name: PayloadOffsetBytes
fields.definition: Actual acquired pointer's offset to aligned payload; zero before alignment preparation and for empty backing. Captured offsets are not used to predict themselves.
fields.overflow: Bounded alignment mask, not a pointer/address authority.

fields.name: PayloadAlignment
fields.definition: Immutable maximum validated field alignment, one for an empty descriptor.

fields.name: LayoutIsPrepared
fields.definition: Alignment preparation actually completed, including empty backing; acquired backing alone after observation failure is insufficient. Sticky through terminal return.

fields.name: InitializationCompleted
fields.definition: Every field and padding finished initialization, even if later cancellation prevents unique publication. Sticky after return; does not authorize use.

fields.name: DescriptorFieldBytes
fields.definition: Descriptor's one pointer, two longs, two ints and actual sequential region-array element storage, excluding CLR headers, array headers, field padding and builder. Shared descriptors are not a second native charge.
fields.overflow: Checked/bounded descriptor count; actual internal element size independently verified.

fields.name: CopiedBytes
fields.definition: Owner-lifetime bytes actually copied by explicit detach, including copied destinations whose later publication fails. Not successful publication count or a user-defined inferred copy.
fields.overflow: Saturates with sticky layout flag without changing exact storage.

fields.name: DetachedOwnerCount
fields.definition: Successfully published independent detach owners, never failed publication or a borrowed field view.
fields.overflow: Saturates independently from actual copied bytes.

fields.name: HistoryOverflowed
fields.definition: Actual unique/permission or layout lifetime history exceeded exact representation. Does not invent measurement unavailability or relax current charge reconciliation.
fields.overflow: Sticky through cleanup; exact maximum alone is not overflow.
